title: GTA 6 launch week got out of hand 😳 #gta6 #shorts
description: Real-world GTA 6 launch stories as reported by Dexerto, FOX 5 and others.

scenes.text: The real world paused for GTA 6
scenes.say: GTA 6 launch week got completely out of hand.
Number three. A professor reportedly canceled homework and exams for launch week.
Number two. An army unit reportedly offered four days off as a reenlistment incentive to play it.
Number one. Reports estimated one and a half million people would skip work for it.
Be honest. What did you skip to play it?
